paragraphs.text: Bow down. Take shelter. Do not wander. Grace conquers — that is the whole door, and the song walks through it: salute, shelter, conquer.

Then whom it bows to, piece by piece. Alone, supreme, a nectar-one ablaze, everything swallowed: venerated. Praised, praiser, praise — three with no difference between them, enduring by becoming knowing-shaped. Melted bliss-mass; His principle likened in form, venerated. As a script outlines a man, so shape reveals the varied You. Entered concept-free, we reflect — and reflection is never caught by fancy. Light made, goddess worded, flowers laid: the guru unfolds, the heart gets entered. Praise mirrored in the body-temple, bonds poured out. Five-named powers conquer; splits gained, mouths called. Limbs to Sadashiva; corpse-self for a seat.

Alone supreme nectar-one ablaze, all-swallowed: venerated. Three-undiffering endure by knowing-shape becoming. Melted bliss-mass; principle likened in form venerated. Script-outlines man; shape reveals varied You. Entered concept-free; reflected never fancy-caught. Light-goddess-flowers arranged; guru unfolded, heart entered. Reflecting praise in body-temple, bonds outpoured. Five-named conquer; splits gained, mouths called. Limbs to SadASiva; corpse-self seat. Full array, bowed limb by limb.
